about.title: A mandala forever
about.subtitle: Mandalas engraved and hand-painted on wooden panels. One-of-a-kind pieces, made to last.

sections.heading: The works
sections.body:
Every piece starts from a wooden panel. The design is engraved by hand, line by line, then painted with colours, gold and silver that fill the grooves and bring the pattern into relief.

Round, square, rectangular, sometimes spread across several panels. No piece is ever made twice: once it finds a home, it stays unique.

sections.heading: My vision
sections.body:
In Sanskrit, mandala means circle. To me it is a way of stopping time: you start from a point and grow outwards, repeating a gesture until disorder becomes form.

Each piece is a diary of those hours. Whoever looks at it can take the same path in reverse, from the edge to the centre.

about.galleryIntro: Alongside the wooden works I explore generative mandalas: shapes built from rules of symmetry, which become studies in colour and rhythm. They are not for sale.
